reason: Playwright checks the media and colorScheme strings at run time and throws for another value. Strider's Emulation.Media is typed, so a value outside the union doesn't compile, and the call has no run-time error to check
Firefox can't emulate media (Emulation's backend table), so the page's media queries keep the browser's own values. The matrix row says Strider has this; it has it on Chromium and stock WebKit only
